environment.sanitizer_note: Benchmarks build without ASan/UBSan: the sanitizers inflate timings by a large and variable factor, so numbers measured under them would not be reproducible. The test suite always runs sanitized.

hardware_notes.standard_suite: Runs on any modern commodity CPU (Apple Silicon M-series, Intel Core i7/i9, AMD Ryzen) with >= 4GB RAM.
hardware_notes.hardware_accelerated_af_xdp: DEFERRED: Requires Linux bare-metal with Intel E810 or Mellanox ConnectX-6 NIC.

environment.artifact_metadata: Every artifact under experiments/results/ carries its own environment block and reproduction_command recording the build that produced it. The values in this manifest describe the supported build matrix, not the machine any particular artifact was measured on.

experiments.name: Verification & Invariant Gate
experiments.description: Builds the tree under ASan and UBSan, verifies the frozen golden vectors, runs the full example and property test suite, and exercises every advertised CLI subcommand.

experiments.name: Adversarial Operator Attack Matrix
experiments.description: Executes 11 mutation attack suites attempting cash creation, asset theft, front-running, overfill, limit price violation, and order censorship.

experiments.name: Complete-Input ZK Accounting Constraint Scaling
experiments.description: Measures Merkle tree and order accounting constraint synthesis across batch sizes.

experiments.name: Single-Batch ZK Proof Scaling Benchmark
experiments.description: Benchmarks R1CS constraint count, witness size, prove latency, and proof footprint for batch sizes N in [2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64].

experiments.name: Two-Step IVC Folding Spike
experiments.description: Evaluates 2-step recursive state transition folding latency and history accumulator binding.

experiments.name: 10-Batch Running Audit Certificate & Tamper Resistance
experiments.description: Generates a 10-batch sequential session proof and verifies historical mutation rejection.

experiments.name: Recursive Folded History vs Independent Proofs Trade-off
experiments.description: Measures storage compression and verifier work comparing folded running audit proofs against independent batch proofs.

experiments.name: Batch-Interval Market Simulation Matrix
experiments.description: Runs multi-interval (10ms..1000ms) multi-seed market quality simulation capturing fill rate, execution delay, and slippage.

experiments.name: Integrated Proof Cost Model & Duty Cycle Analysis
experiments.description: Integrates empirical ZK benchmarks with multi-interval market simulation datasets to measure cryptographic load per cleared lot and real-time duty cycle.

experiments.name: Nasdaq TotalView-ITCH 5.0 Parsing & L3 Book Replay
experiments.description: Tests binary ITCH 5.0 streaming parser, truncation fuzzing, and deterministic Level-3 order book BBO extraction. Covered by the gate's test suite rather than by a benchmark artifact.

experiments.name: Plaintext Engine Performance Profiling & Scaling
experiments.description: Profiles execution latency (mean, p50, p90, p99) and order throughput across batch sizes.

experiments.name: Clearing Optimality Constraint Metrics
experiments.description: Measures the candidate-price ladder and constraint growth of the clearing-optimality subrelation.

experiments.name: Auction Optimization Comparison
experiments.description: Compares auction clearing implementations on the same batches to quantify the effect of the optimization on execution latency.
